title: Can't get past the Drowned Market — any tips?

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone, I’m really stuck at the Drowned Market level and could use some advice. The area feels way more complex than the earlier locations, with the shifting platforms and all the underwater passages making navigation super tricky. I keep getting lost or missing the key items needed to unlock doors. Has anyone found a reliable way to keep track of where you’ve been or any must-grab items that are easy to overlook?

Also, is it just me, or did the remaster change some of the audio cues in that area? I remember the original version had this subtle music shift when you were close to secret paths, but now it feels a bit muted or different. If anyone has tips on how to use the music to guide exploration or if there’s a particular line of sight to watch for, I’d be really grateful!

Thanks in advance! This is one of my favorite spots in the game once you get past the initial frustration, but I just need a little nudge to push through.
